root_cause.before: pgrep -af over broad command-line substrings: unitree_mujoco|ros2 launch|ros2_control_node
root_cause.observed: the active Codex sandbox command line contained the MuJoCo path and was classified as residual

detection_rule.excluded: self PID and complete ancestor PID chain
detection_rule.mujoco_match: exact expected executable path, including a deleted-instance suffix
detection_rule.ros_launch_match: ros2 launcher executable with exact argv sequence: launch rl_quadruped_controller mujoco.launch.py
detection_rule.controller_match: ros2_control_node executable with exact source or installed Go2 robot_control.yaml path
detection_rule.shell_path_only: not a match when inspected executable is unrelated
detection_rule.zombie: relevant zombie identity is uncertain and rejected
detection_rule.uncertain: process table read failure, malformed identity, or ambiguous controller attribution
